explication: obsidian.nvim is a Neovim plugin for working with Markdown-based Obsidian vaults. A user invokes the `Obsidian` command or configured keymaps; commands and actions support note creation, search, navigation, and editing, while completion and LSP features provide in-editor assistance. The README also documents daily notes, templates, images, status, and optional Obsidian Sync. Paths identify source modules from the tree; because sampled excerpts do not cover runtime Lua, relationships below rely on documented README behavior rather than inspected call sites.
